nodes.description: Owner address; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control guard for privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of approvals, decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Total token supply, computed in the constructor with an unchecked multiplication.
Whitelisted trade address checked in ensure(); settable by the owner only.
Mapping of addresses allowed to bypass the sale-condition check.
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and compared against _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount computed in init() with unchecked multiplication.
Maximum sale amount computed in init() with unchecked multiplication.
Maximum number of sales per address, set in init().
ERC20 token name.
ERC20 token symbol.
Token decimals constant (18) used in the supply and sale-limit scaling.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transfer entry point; performs unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic and sale checks.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Whitelist/condition gate; calls pairFor and condition to decide whether a transfer is allowed.
Sale-condition checks against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and payload.
Owner-only initialisation of sale limits using unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch airdrop performing unchecked multiplication and loop arithmetic over balances.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply and granting unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Internal helper returning msg.sender from the Context base contract.
Internal _transfer moving balances via SafeMath checks.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorisation, allowance and balance bookkeeping.
delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata, executing external code with this contract's storage and balance context.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic uint total = _value * _tos.length plus balanceOf updates inside an unbounded loop in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplications token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) in init().
Unchecked multiplication _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) when minting the initial supply.
_from parameter of transferFrom, the debited account and whitelist key.
_to parameter of transferFrom, the credited account.
_value parameter of transferFrom, the amount moved.
_tos array parameter of batchSend, the recipient list.
_value parameter of batchSend, the per-recipient amount.
local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
saleNum parameter of init(), assigned to _saleNum.
token parameter of init(), scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init(), scaled into _maxSale.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress, written into tradeAddress.
a parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall target address.
b parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall payload bytes.
_spender parameter of approve().

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the caller directly controls the privileged owner state variable.
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from and on allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] under caller control.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
ensure() bypasses the sale condition when _from or _to equals the owner address.
The owner check gates the delegatecall in delegate().
The owner check gates init().
The owner check gates batchSend().
The owner check gates setTradeAddress().
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom().
Base ERC20 transfer() routes through the internal _transfer helper.
transferFrom() requires ensure() to succeed before moving balances.
ensure() falls back to the condition() sale checks for non-whitelisted accounts.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address through pairFor().
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() performs the unchecked allowance decrement.
transferFrom() performs the unchecked balance decrement.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] with unchecked arithmetic.
delegate() forwards both the target address and payload into an arbitrary delegatecall.
batchSend() computes total and updates balances without overflow checks.
init() scales the sale limits with unchecked multiplications.
The constructor scales the initial supply with an unchecked multiplication.
init() assigns the scaled token amount to _minSale.
init() assigns the scaled maxToken amount to _maxSale.
The constructor result of the unchecked multiplication is stored in totalSupply.
init() writes the saleNum parameter into _saleNum.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
_onSaleNum is incremented outside condition() while condition() relies on it.
_from indexes the balance debited by the unchecked subtraction.
_from indexes the allowance decremented by the unchecked subtraction.
_value is the amount removed from balanceOf[_from] without a SafeMath guard.
_to indexes the credited balance entry.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked total computation in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow checks.
The local total is the unchecked product used for the balance debit.
total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without a SafeMath guard.
The saleNum parameter is stored directly into _saleNum.
token is scaled by 10**decimals inside the unchecked multiplication.
maxToken is scaled by 10**decimals inside the unchecked multiplication.
addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
The attacker-influenced address a becomes the delegatecall target.
The payload b becomes the delegatecall calldata.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve().
The constructor sets owner to the deploying caller.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
The internal _transfer helper moves balanceOf entries.

normalization_plan.reason: _from only exists as the transferFrom source argument and is captured by the transferFrom function node.
_to only exists as the transferFrom destination argument and is captured by the transferFrom function node.
_value is the unchecked amount subtracted from balanceOf in transferFrom, so it is folded into the unsafe balance subtraction node.
_tos is only used to compute the unchecked total in batchSend, folding into the unsafe batch arithmetic node.
The batchSend _value is multiplied by _tos.length unchecked, folding into the unsafe batch arithmetic node.
total is the unchecked multiplication result that drives the batchSend balance debit.
saleNum is assigned directly to _saleNum inside init() with no further computation.
token is scaled by 10**decimals in the unchecked _minSale computation.
maxToken is scaled by 10**decimals in the unchecked _maxSale computation.
addr is stored directly into tradeAddress by the setter function.
a is the delegatecall target and is fully absorbed by the unsafe delegatecall operation.
b is the delegatecall calldata and is fully absorbed by the unsafe delegatecall operation.
_spender only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve().
